settings.title: Your Business Has Outgrown WhatsApp and Spreadsheets

settings.html:
Bookings and orders live in WhatsApp chats and a notebook. Nobody has the full picture.

You don't know who has paid, who owes you, or which deposits are still outstanding.

Your team can't see what each other is doing, so the same questions get asked every day.

That's what we fix.

settings.title: Systems Built Around How You Actually Work

settings.html:
Custom Dashboards

One screen for your whole operation: clients, jobs, money and team, updated in real time on any device.

Booking & Payment Systems

Clients book, choose dates and pay deposits online. Confirmations, invoices and reminders go out automatically.

Client Portals

Every client gets a secure link to see their booking, pay, sign forms, upload documents and download invoices. No app download.

Staff & Field Apps

Clock-ins with GPS, job reports with photos, leave requests and team views, all from a phone browser.

WhatsApp & AI Automation

WhatsApp confirmations and reminders, plus AI that reads documents and posters so nobody types data twice.

Monitoring & Support

We host, monitor and maintain your system, with security updates, backups and fixes handled for you.

VR Travelcations was taking bookings on WhatsApp and chasing deposits by hand. We built a complete travel platform: clients browse trips, pay a deposit online and manage everything from a personal portal on their phone. The same system now powers a second travel agency, fully separate, with its own branding, staff, trips and payments.

Read the full case study →

AI Poster Scanner

Upload a trip poster and the system fills in the name, dates, price, inclusions and deposit automatically.

Smart Client Portals

A PIN-protected link on WhatsApp: view booking, pay instalments, sign the indemnity, upload passport, download invoice.

Automated Booking Flow

Deposit paid, booking confirmed, portal link sent, reminders scheduled. Zero manual steps.

Two Agencies, One System

One codebase runs two travel businesses with completely separate data and branding.

Real-Time Admin

A special published from a phone at 9pm is live on the website in seconds.

Smart Room Pairing

Solo travellers paired by pickup point, age, package and dietary needs, with a reason for each match.

100/100 Performance

Code splitting, WebP images, service workers and CDN delivery for a perfect Lighthouse score.

Security Audited

41/41 security tests passing. Passport numbers encrypted, every access logged. POPIA compliant.

Facility Services · Operations Platform
250+Staff managed
60+Active sites
7Divisions on one platform
12 → 1Tools replaced

Turclea is a South African facility services company running cleaning, pest control, landscaping and more across 9 provinces. Staff records, attendance, tenders and safety files lived in spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups and paper. We built OpsCore, one platform that connects staff, sites, tenders, safety, quotes and invoices, used every day in production.

AI Tender Compilation

Upload the client's documents. AI extracts the scope and BOQ, prices it and compiles a submission-ready ZIP.

WhatsApp Clock-In

Staff clock in from a link with GPS confirmation. Supervisors are alerted when someone is off-site.

Staff Portal

Any phone browser, employee number and PIN. Clock in, submit job reports with photos, request leave.

Digital Safety Files

A 17-section OHS safety file per site, shared with auditors through a secure link. No printing.

Quote Engine

Labour with all SA statutory levies, equipment, overheads and 3-year escalation, as branded PDFs.

Client Portal

Clients see their site's job reports, safety file, equipment and progress, and comment before sign-off.

Job Cards & POs

Raised from the field, approved by value up the chain, suppliers notified on WhatsApp.

Live Operations Dashboard

The director sees attendance, sites, tenders and finances in real time.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: No. Every system is built around your workflow, your roles and your business rules. We reuse proven building blocks so it's faster to build, but you're never forced into someone else's process.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Who owns the system and the data?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Your data is yours and lives under your own accounts. You can export it at any time. We build and maintain the system for you, and the details of ownership are set out clearly in your quote.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: How long does it take to build?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Most systems go live in stages within a few weeks. You start using the first modules early while we keep building. Our travel booking platform went from brief to live in 3 weeks.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: Do my staff or clients need to download an app?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: No. Everything works in a phone browser through a secure link, including staff portals and client portals. WhatsApp links are used where it makes sense.

Every system is quoted after a free discovery session, because the price depends on what it needs to do. You get one fixed quote with a 50% deposit to start and 50% on launch, so there are no surprises.
We monitor the system, apply security updates, run backups and fix issues on a monthly support plan. When you need new features, we build them on the platform you already know.
